bundle.fiber_cubic_transport: N_h(y)=N(P_h.T y), with P_h translation permutation of 27 E6 mode labels
bundle.interpretation: The lifted transport commutes with the on-site clock because each fiber transports its cubic. This construction is a mathematically consistent but gauge-trivial pure relabeling and does not restore invariance of one fixed global N under the old 27 history permutations.

continuum.Clifford_alpha_beta: 4x4 conventional complex Dirac alpha1,alpha2,alpha3 and beta
continuum.selection_warning: The 4-spinor Clifford matrices, integer lattice lifts, Wilson term, and scale parameter r are external design inputs, not derived from the finite W33/E6/H27 data. The finite 27-site torus has momenta only 0 and +/-2pi/3, so no controlled low-k continuum without a sequence of enlarging lattices.
